rationale: The student focuses on individual digit magnitude (9s vs 0s/1s) rather than comparing digits by place value starting from the highest place (thousands). A place-value comparison demonstration will explicitly show comparing the thousands column first.
intent: Demonstrate compare on the place-value with values [2988,3012]. Tutor points at: thousands place

frames.caption: Line up 2,988 and 3,012 by place. Start with the biggest place.
3 thousands is more than 2 thousands, so 3,012 is greater than 2,988. The smaller places cannot catch up, even if they are 9s.

judgement.reasoning: The demonstration directly addresses the exact obstacle ('The smaller places cannot catch up, even if they are 9s') using a worked example (2,988 vs 3,012) highlighting the highest place value. It provides a visual worked example rather than interactive chart dictation, which reduces load while confronting the misconception.
judgement.verdict: A teacher would immediately use this targeted worked demo because it explicitly tackles the misconception that nines in lower places outweigh a larger leading digit.
